<!-- go-get= pins an imported module to an older version than the one `go mod tidy` picks (a downgrade). That version's own dependencies need go.sum entries too; without a second `tidy` after `go get` the build stops with "missing go.sum entry". Needs network the first time (testify). -->

```{.go .run .test .output go-get="github.com/stretchr/testify@v1.11.1"}
package main

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestTrue(t *testing.T) {
	assert.True(t, true)
}
```
